notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Summer Sale Update – Laser Pointer & Ping Overhaul!


 Laser Pointer Tool: Hold Ctrl / Cmd + Left or Right Click to use the new laser pointer feature.
 You can now ping with a double-click, or stick with the classic Left Click + Space.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Some resource management optimization for better performance,
 Fixed an issue with loading save files that could cause a "failed to load – try again" error,
 Fixed an issue where tooltips would sometimes fail to load or appear,
 Video backgrounds can now be controlled—pause, adjust volume, restart, and more,
 Fixed an issue where resized WEBM props with unlinked width and height would reset upon scene reload, causing them to appear incorrectly,
 Fixed a bug where deleted background files caused a black screen when reloading the save file

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Possibility to not have the default assets loaded when the program starts (It speeds up the application if you turn it off in Settings. If you turn it on again, the default library will reappear. You can download the default files separately from here: DLC Download)
In FOW mode you can scroll to zoom in and out and undo fow operations (no more accidental reveal)
Videos, animations random frame start on/off from settings

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.18
notes.notes:
New features and bug fixes: 

 Particle effect preview in the library: A small preview appears in the middle of the screen for the GM when the mouse is hovering over a particle effect in the library
 Removing user assets: Right-click on an asset in the library to remove it
 Webm assets' new location in the library: Webm files, which are typically animated effects or animated tokens, are now listed in the library under the "animations" tab instead of in the videos
 Fixed a bug where the small crossed-out eye icon did not appear next to the non-visible webm file
 Fixed a bug where the grid was overlayed on top of all props when weather effect was applied to the scene
 Fixed a bug where an alert message indicating missing assets was displayed in huge letters on the scene
 Fixed a bug where scaling a prop with input fields distorted the asset
 Fixed a bug where when using the rectangular tool in fog of war reveal, selecting a tiny area accidentally revealed the entire scene
 Fixed a bug where the program did not automatically return to prop mode when closing the AOE tool window

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
In early July, we released a patch to Editor to fix that FOW did not respect background rotation, and the scaling of rotated AOE tools was not working properly, and that the size of the fast scene selector could not be adjusted.
Unfortunately, a bug slipped in during the process, which caused the background and the props to lose their rotation values when leaving the scene.
Today we fixed this bug with a hotfix. The only way we could do this was to make FOW inactive as long as no background is loaded into the scene. If you want to work on a scene without a background, load the black background from the deafult assets if you want to use Fog of War. 
Ctrl + scrolling the mouse let you change the size of tiles in the fast scene selector.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
New features:

Added Ruler / Measurement tool and Area of Effect Tool (line, square, sphere, cone)

Added background rotation (Find it on the background panel)

Prop visibility feedback for the DM (If the prop is invisible, a small crossed-out eye appears in the corner)

Right click hover menu in the Library to set the asset as Background or Overlay

Grid masking tool - now you can remove the grid anywhere on the background

(If you activate the grid mode, you can draw with the mouse to mask out areas. Scrolling the mouse changes the size of the masking brush. Hold Shift to redraw)

Added "ESC" (exit application pop-up) in the Welcome screen and in the Story View screen

Fast Scene selector window size increased

Webms start from a random frame (so animated tokens do not move at the same time)
Bug fixes:

Fixed Fog of War tool becomes invisible if we zoom in/out

Dragging background with right-click in Fog of War mode

Full-screen mode does not jump back to windowed mode

notes.title: Prioritising new features of the Dynamic Dungeons Editor (Steam version)
notes.notes:
Hey there Dynamic Dungeons Editor users,

Our desire to upgrade Dynamic Dungeons Editor and fix any bugs is still unwavering, thus a new editor update is yet to come in the upcoming months.

As we are not programmers, a new Unity developer team is now tasked with developing Editor. This is a new team taking over and testing every bug and dealing with feature requests.

In case you have noticed a reoccurring bug then please let us now! (If you have contacted us already but the bug still exists it means we have not been able to reproduce it yet. If this is the case, then please message us again using this bug report form, and at the same time you might as well want to send us a video with the problem itself.)

As far as feature requests are concerned, we must add that we don’t intend to compete with other mapmaking applications, as Editor is mainly a player software focusing on displaying the Maps and in-person tabletop play. However, we would like to upgrade on performance and add functions of convenience, the likes of which we would appreciate your opinion and votes about.

Please help us prioritize the tasks at hand and rank the importance of these features on a scale of 1 to 5, where 1 meaning “no need”, 2 is “can get by without”, 3 is “not that important”, 4 is “important” and 5: “must do”.

Click here to rank the feature requests!

Thank you!
